# Tools

<!-- Generated by scripts/tool_docs.py from the registered tools. Do not edit by hand. -->

50 tools, 36 of them read-only. Tools that change anything are registered only with `OITC_ENABLE_WRITE_TOOLS=true`.

**Size** is the definition a model receives with every request - name, description and input schema as compact JSON - in characters. Roughly 3.1 to 3.7 characters make one token; see [tool-design.md](tool-design.md).

## `triage`

What is broken, since when, whether it is already handled, and whether the monitoring itself is at fault.

12 tools, 9380 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `get_host_info` | reads | `hostname` | 827 | Detailed status of a host plus the services running on it. |
| `get_monitoring_engine_stats` | reads | - | 442 | Health of the monitoring engine itself: how many hosts and services it watches, and its check throughput and latency. |
| `list_host_acknowledgements` | reads | `hostname`, `limit?` | 821 | Acknowledgement history for one host: who acknowledged a problem, when, and with what comment. |
| `list_host_checks` | reads | `hostname`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 815 | Individual check executions for a host, newest first: output, latency and execution time per run. |
| `list_host_downtimes` | reads | `hostname?`, `only_active?`, `limit?` | 711 | Scheduled and running downtimes for hosts. |
| `list_host_state_changes` | reads | `hostname`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 720 | Only the entries where a host's state changed, i.e. the timeline of an incident rather than every check run. |
| `list_log_entries` | reads | `hours?`, `limit?` | 550 | Host and service alert log entries from the last `hours` hours, newest first. |
| `list_service_acknowledgements` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename`, `limit?` | 891 | Acknowledgement history for one service: who acknowledged a problem, when, and with what comment. |
| `list_service_checks` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 1170 | Individual check executions for a service, newest first: output, latency and execution time per run. |
| `list_service_downtimes` | reads | `hostname?`, `servicename?`, `only_active?`, `limit?` | 802 | Scheduled and running downtimes for services. |
| `list_service_state_changes` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename`, `hours?`, `limit?` | 904 | Only the entries where a service's state changed. |
| `list_services_by_state` | reads | `state`, `limit?` | 727 | Services currently in a given state. |

## `patch`

5 tools, 3692 characters.

## `catalog`

Look up what exists - templates, commands, contacts, groups, containers - without changing anything.

10 tools, 6058 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `get_allowed_elements_for_container` | reads | `object_type`, `container_name?` | 1629 | List the host templates, contacts, contact groups, timeperiods, host groups, etc. that are actually visible from a given container - i.e. the values a Create* tool for that object_type would accept there. openITCOCKPIT restricts every such reference to the target container's own scope (the container plus its descendants, plus a few legacy tenant-wide exceptions); values outside that scope are rejected. |
| `get_container_tree` | reads | `container_name?` | 484 | Get the organizational structure (containers: tenants, locations, nodes) starting at the given container, including which hosts, host groups and service groups live directly under it. |
| `list_commands` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 588 | Find monitoring commands (check, notification and event-handler commands) by name. |
| `list_contactgroups` | reads | `limit?` | 356 | List contact groups (named groups of contacts used for notifications). |
| `list_contacts` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 529 | Find contacts (people who can be notified) by name. |
| `list_hostgroups` | reads | `limit?` | 412 | List host groups with their name and description. |
| `list_hosttemplates` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 655 | Find host templates (reusable check/notification configurations for hosts) by name. |
| `list_servicegroups` | reads | `limit?` | 400 | List service groups with their name and description. |
| `list_servicetemplategroups` | reads | `limit?` | 402 | List service template groups (named groups of service templates, used e.g. to bulk-apply services to hosts). |
| `list_servicetemplates` | reads | `name_filter?`, `limit?` | 603 | Find service templates (reusable check/notification configurations for services) by name. |

## `health`

Find hosts and services across the estate and see how one is doing - its state, what likely explains a problem, recent changes.

11 tools, 10897 characters.

| Tool | Effect | Parameters | Size | What it is for |
|---|---|---|---:|---|
| `explain_notification` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename?`, `hours?` | 936 | Why a host or service did or did not notify: its settings, contacts and state checked the way Naemon checks them - disabled, downtime, soft state, host down, state not subscribed, acknowledged, no contact - and the notifications sent recently. |
| `find_downtimes` | reads | `host?`, `service?`, `comment?`, `running_only?`, `kind?`, `limit?` | 1023 | Find running and planned downtimes of hosts and services, by host, service or comment. |
| `find_hosts` | reads | `name?`, `state?`, `container?`, `hostgroup?`, `acknowledged?`, `in_downtime?`, `limit?` | 1373 | Find hosts by name, state, container or host group, and count them per state. |
| `find_noisy_checks` | reads | `hours?`, `older_than_hours?`, `container?`, `hostgroup?`, `limit?` | 1013 | Checks that cause noise and what to do about each: flapping services, the services that notified most, and problems that have lasted without anyone acknowledging them or scheduling a downtime. |
| `find_services` | reads | `host?`, `name?`, `state?`, `container?`, `hostgroup?`, `acknowledged?`, `in_downtime?`, `flapping?`, `limit?` | 1640 | Find services by host, name, state, container, host group or flapping, and count them per state. |
| `get_host_health` | reads | `hostname`, `hours?` | 777 | How one host is doing: state and since when, what likely explains a problem (a down parent, a downtime, an acknowledgement), which hosts depend on it, its services by state, and recent state changes. |
| `get_problem_overview` | reads | `container?`, `hostgroup?`, `groups?` | 748 | What is broken and what is only a consequence: down hosts and the unreachable hosts and services behind them, the remaining unhandled service problems grouped by service, and what is already in a downtime or acknowledged. |
| `get_service_health` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename`, `hours?` | 877 | How one service is doing: state and since when, what likely explains a problem (its host down, a downtime, an acknowledgement), and recent state changes. |
| `get_shift_summary` | reads | `hours?` | 493 | A handover of the last hours: problems that began, what someone acknowledged or put in a downtime, how many notifications went out, and what is still open from before. |
| `investigate_problem` | reads | `hostname`, `servicename?`, `days?`, `around_minutes?` | 1123 | What happened around a problem: when it began, whether it happened before and how long it lasted then, which other hosts and services failed in the same minutes, and which configuration changes and exports came before. |
| `list_catalog` | reads | `kind`, `name?`, `limit?` | 894 | List templates, commands, contacts, groups or time periods by name, sorted by name, to find the exact name another tool needs. |
